references.text: Enoch walked with God and was taken away. Verse 21 introduces the description of Enoch's life and his son Methuselah.
Methuselah, who was born when Enoch was 65 years old, lived on and had a son named Lamech.
Enoch and Methuselah are mentioned in the genealogy from Adam, confirming the genealogical connection.
Enoch is mentioned as an example of faith in the New Testament because he was taken up to God.
Jude refers to Enoch as the seventh from Adam, which confirms his placement in the genealogy in Genesis 5.
Highlights the contrast between Enoch's translation and Methuselah's death, emphasizing human mortality.
